selection.diff_summary:
Summary: Refactors offload runtime block-limit computation to depend on the requested per-block thread count instead of using a fixed team limit. The generic device interface now exposes getBlockLimit(NumThreads), and AMDGPU overrides it to derive a maximum block count from the product of max teams and thread limit divided by the launch thread count, with saturation to UINT32_MAX. Kernel launch sizing logic is updated to clamp both user-requested and preferred block counts against this thread-aware limit, changing effective launch configuration selection on AMDGPU.
